# Edit kinds

Generated by `npm run learn-publish -- --kinds-md` from `src/learning/kinds.ts` - do not edit by hand;
`tests/meta/learning.spec.ts` fails if this file drifts from the code.

| Kind | Direction | Skill area | What it is | When engineers make this edit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locator-upgraded` | improvement | locator-source-strategy | Move to a more stable locator strategy | A CSS, XPath, id or text selector kept breaking or matched the wrong element, and was replaced by a role, label, test-id or placeholder locator. |
| `locator-replaced` | neutral | locator-source-strategy | Selector updated after it went stale | The same kind of locator was given a new value because the app changed. |
| `locator-downgraded` | regression | locator-source-strategy | Moved to a less stable locator strategy | A role, label or test-id locator was replaced by CSS, XPath or text, usually to make a failing step pass. |
| `locator-fallback-added` | improvement | locator-source-strategy | Hybrid locator: primary plus fallback | One locator was not reliable across builds or environments, so an alternative was added (a fallbacks entry in the locator repository, or .or() in code). |
| `locator-fallback-removed` | neutral | locator-source-strategy | Fallback removed | A fallback locator was deleted. |
| `locator-scoped` | improvement | locator-source-strategy | Scope a locator instead of picking by position | A positional .first()/.nth()/.last() locator was replaced by one scoped to a region, row or filter. |
| `sync-sleep-replaced` | improvement | synchronization-strategy | Replace a hard sleep with a condition | A waitForTimeout() was replaced by a web-first assertion or a wait for the condition it was standing in for. |
| `sync-sleep-removed` | improvement | synchronization-strategy | Remove a hard sleep | A waitForTimeout() was deleted; Playwright's auto-waiting covered it. |
| `sync-wait-added` | improvement | synchronization-strategy | Add an explicit wait for a specific signal | A step raced an asynchronous result (a response, navigation, popup or polled value) and a targeted wait was added. |
| `sync-sleep-added` | regression | synchronization-strategy | Hard sleep added | waitForTimeout() was added to make a step pass. |
| `sync-timeout-raised` | regression | synchronization-strategy | Timeout raised | A per-step or per-assertion timeout was increased to make a slow step pass. |
| `sync-force-added` | regression | synchronization-strategy | force: true added | An action was forced to click through something that was not actionable. |
| `sync-force-removed` | improvement | synchronization-strategy | force: true removed | A forced action was made normal again. |
| `assertion-added` | improvement | assertion-strategy | Assertion added | A step or screen had no check of its outcome and a web-first assertion was added. |
| `verification-added` | improvement | verification-strategy | Verify the result of an action | An action that changes the page (save, submit, login, delete, search) was followed by another step without checking its outcome; an assertion was added right after it. |
| `assertion-strengthened` | improvement | assertion-strategy | Assertion made more precise | A weak matcher (toBeVisible, toContainText, toBeTruthy) was replaced by one that checks the actual value. |
| `assertion-weakened` | regression | assertion-strategy | Assertion weakened | A precise matcher was replaced by a looser one, usually to get past a failure. |
| `assertion-removed` | regression | assertion-strategy | Assertion removed | An assertion was deleted. |
| `expectation-updated` | neutral | assertion-strategy | Expected value updated | The same assertion now expects a different value. |
| `data-externalized` | improvement | framework-scaffolding | Move a hardcoded value to configuration | A literal (URL, account, id) was replaced by an environment variable or config value. |
| `data-hardcoded` | regression | framework-scaffolding | Value hardcoded in the test | A configuration or environment value was replaced by a literal. |
| `data-guard-added` | improvement | framework-scaffolding | Guard for missing test data | A test crashed deep inside a step because required data was not provided; a skip or clear failure was added up front. |
